name: Antares
tagline: Workhorse for Cygnus ISS resupply through NG-19
description: Northrop Grumman's medium-lift launcher, originally built around the Aerojet AJ26 and later RD-181 first stages with a Castor solid second stage. Carried Cygnus to the ISS from 2013 through NG-19 in 2023. The Antares 330 successor (jointly developed with Firefly Aerospace) replaces the Russian first stage with seven Miranda engines.
best_known_for: Workhorse for Cygnus ISS resupply through NG-19
